verdict.rationale: Brex markets built-in AI assistants and agents that take work off users' hands. Assistants write memos, fetch receipts, give policy help and file reimbursements; review and audit agents approve, escalate and categorize expenses; and Brex AI drafts bill payments. The MCP server serves external assistants, so it is not credited for this built-in story. Missing for 10: documentation of how users assign arbitrary or ad-hoc tasks to the assistant (e.g., a conversational interface), depth beyond marketing pages, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
